description: The screen shows a split-view development setup on Windows with Azure Data Studio or similar SQL IDE on the left side containing SQL queries with syntax highlighting (visible code includes SELECT statements, FROM clauses with LEFT JOIN, and WHERE conditions filtering by table_name), and what appears to be a browser window on the right showing a dark-themed web application (possibly Claude.ai or similar chat interface) with a conversation panel visible. The center of the screen displays an overlay dialog or dropdown menu showing a list of what appears to be database objects or file names with timestamps (formatted as dates like "Jan 16" and times), with options visible including items that look like schema or table listings. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as 9:32 PM, and the overall workspace suggests the user is performing database development or querying tasks while referencing documentation or AI assistance.

The screen shows a split-view development setup on Windows with DBeaver (database IDE) on the left displaying SQL query results in a grid showing table metadata with columns like table_size, table_name, and numerical values, alongside SQL code visible in an editor tab. On the right side is a Microsoft Edge browser window open to what appears to be a Claude AI chat interface (claude.ai) with the characteristic dark theme, showing a conversation sidebar on the left with multiple chat sessions listed (partially visible timestamps and conversation titles), and the main chat area on the right displaying a text input field at the bottom with "Message Claude" placeholder text. The user appears to be idle or reading, with the cursor visible in the center of the Claude chat window, and both applications are fully loaded without any dialogs or loading indicators.

The screen shows a split-view development environment with Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) on the left side displaying a SQL query editor with a SELECT statement querying table metadata (selecting table_size, table_rows, time_created, table_name from information schema), along with a results grid showing database table information. On the right side, a Microsoft Edge browser is open to what appears to be a Microsoft 365 Copilot or Azure AI assistant interface with a dark theme, showing a chat panel with the prompt "Message Copilot" at the bottom and various AI assistant options in a sidebar including "Start with Copilot". The user appears to be working between database management and an AI assistant, with the cursor positioned in the chat area on the right. The Windows 11 taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as 5:57 PM.

The screen shows a split view with DBeaver SQL editor on the left side displaying a SQL query that performs a JOIN operation between tables, selecting columns like table_size, table_name, and time_created, with a WHERE clause filtering by table_name pattern 'ev1_idf_final_[1-8]pct[0]' - the query results are visible in a yellow-highlighted data grid below showing multiple rows of table metadata. On the right side is a Microsoft Edge browser window open to what appears to be an Azure portal or similar cloud interface (visible at msft.sb.azuresynapse.net) showing a dark-themed panel with "Manage Layers" section containing a hierarchical list of database objects and various expandable items like "dbo.all_tables" with checkboxes.

The screen shows a split-view development environment with Extended Logic (a SQL query editor) on the left side displaying a SQL query that selects table_size, table_name, time_created columns from all_tables with a WHERE clause filtering table_name like '%t_135_file%'. On the right side is a ChatGPT web interface in dark mode showing a conversation list in the sidebar with entries like "Chat GPT4 Integration", "Get 1000th Element", "Java Date Function" and others. The main chat area shows a message input field at the bottom with placeholder text "Message ChatGPT" and the conversation appears to be empty or scrolled up. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom showing the time as 9:23 PM.
